item.title: Witkoff and Kushner meet with Putin to discuss Ukraine peace
item.description: President Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin on Saturday to discuss U.S. proposals for ending the Ukraine war.

item.title: GOP midterm convention speakers list revealed
item.description: President Trump and top allies will appear alongside Republican candidates in key competitive races at next week's GOP event.

item.title: Republican economic confidence drops sharply
item.description: Republican confidence in the economy has fallen over six months at a pace not seen since Covid, similar to past downturns.

item.title: GOP accepts Trump's self-focused midterm strategy
item.description: Trump is campaigning, making the midterms about himself, a move many Republicans reluctantly accept with 59 days left.
